newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Scania Q1 profit seen 608 mln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Scania Q1 profit seen 608 mln SKR.

text.p: Swedish truck market Scania was expected to post a lower profit after financial items of 608 million crowns for the first quarter of 1997, according to a Reuters poll of 10 analysts.

For the same period a year ago Scania posted a profit after financial items of 1.11 billion crowns. This was its first interim report since its April 1, 1996, return to the Stockholm and New York stock exchanges.

For the full year 1997 Scania's profit was expected to reach 3.33 billion crowns against 2.71 billion crowns in 1996. This forecast was 13 percent lower than analysts estimated at the time of the company's last report.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Penser FK, Fiba Nordic, Foreningsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Myrberg & Wiklund, Swedbank, and Ohman.
Scania's report will be released on April 24.
